summary: Added a backward-compatible --prefill-cp-min-tokens option that selects the CP or replicated path independently for each prefill forward using its logical processed-token count. The runtime decision covers zigzag and interleave strategies, excludes cached-prefix length and runner padding, filters CP CUDA-graph capture buckets consistently, and restores non-CP DSA indexer fast paths for below-threshold batches.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: the unmodified strategy initializer rejected the new runtime threshold contract. Raw output: reports/j-81eccd34a26d/raw/failing_before_threshold.txt

30 tests and 18 subtests passed, covering CLI parsing, invalid negative values, threshold propagation, legacy default compatibility, exact threshold activation, below-threshold bypass, cached-prefix follow-ups, padding resistance, and existing CP metadata/sharding behavior. Raw output: reports/j-81eccd34a26d/raw/focused_after_format.txt
Repository formatting, imports, lint, AST, secret, spelling, and registered-test checks passed. Raw output: reports/j-81eccd34a26d/raw/pre_commit_final.txt

The assigned AMD Instinct MI355X was visible through torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and executed a simple GPU reduction; the actual prefill-CP startup path raised the repository's explicit HIP/NPU/MUSA deprecation error. Raw output: reports/j-81eccd34a26d/raw/gpu_environment.txt

gpu_execution.evidence: No prefill-CP forward could execute on the assigned GPU because this checkout rejects prefill CP on HIP. Only a device availability/reduction probe ran; it is not claimed as feature validation.

remaining_limitations: The reported GLM-5.2-FP8 DSA workload and its model weights were unavailable.
The assigned GPU is an AMD Instinct MI355X with ROCm 7.2, while this checkout explicitly rejects prefill CP on HIP; the source report used NVIDIA B30Z GPUs and CUDA.
No end-to-end TTFT comparison or independent GPU numerical comparison of CP versus non-CP outputs was possible on the available architecture.

The optimal threshold is deployment- and model-specific; the new option defaults to 0 for compatibility and operators must set it from measurements (for example 8192 for the source report's observed break-even).
No native code changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
